import pandas as pd
# Convert '일자' to datetime if not already
df['일자'] = pd.to_datetime(df['일자'])
# Extract weekday name in Korean
df['weekday'] = df['일자'].dt.dayofweek.map({0:'월', 1:'화', 2:'수', 3:'목', 4:'금', 5:'토', 6:'일'})
# Extract hour from '시작시각'
df['hour'] = df['시작시각'].str.split(':').str[0].astype(int)
